corpus.source_parity: Identical 20 deterministic exact-integer and fixed-point RCE kernels (k01_sha256_block through k20_kalman_q16) as Wave 4 E4-Energy.

experiment: E4-Prelude: Pre-Compiled librce_rt.rlib Shared Runtime Crate vs Monolithic Embedded Prelude

falsifiers.F1_checksum_mismatch: Any of the 20 kernels linked against librce_rt.rlib diverges by >= 1 bit on the 2,000-seed unsigned batch checksum from Wave 4's verified reference checksums.
falsifiers.F2_no_compile_energy_reduction: Per-kernel compile_core_reported_j of rce check + emit rust -> rustc -O3 (shared librce_rt.rlib) fails to improve by at least 10x over the monolithic prelude build on the same CPU core.
falsifiers.F6_idle_drift: Pre- vs post-run idle power drift > 10% invalidates derived marginal package energy (gross core and package reported_j are always reported alongside the Falsifier 6 flag).

method.one_time_prelude_build: Extract RCE's 2,232-line value/task runtime prelude (src/emit/rt.rs + DISPLAY_ESCAPE table + RceProgramHooks dispatch vtable) once into rce_rt.rs and compile librce_rt.rlib once via rustc --edition 2024 --crate-type=rlib -C opt-level=3 rce_rt.rs, recording its one-time amortizable core_reported_j, pkg_reported_j, wall_s, and .rlib byte size.
method.per_kernel_build: For each of the 20 RCE Forms (k01..k20), run rce check + rce emit rust, strip the shared prelude in favor of `extern crate rce_rt; use rce_rt::*;` + RceProgramHooks registration, and compile via rustc --edition 2024 -C opt-level=3 --extern rce_rt=librce_rt.rlib, measuring per-kernel compile_core_reported_j, compile_pkg_reported_j, compile_wall_s, artifact_bytes, and per-invocation run_core_reported_j, run_pkg_reported_j, run_wall_s.
payback_metrics: Per-kernel marginal payback N* (assuming pre-built toolchain librce_rt.rlib) for `rce check + 5-target emit (node js)` -> `rce check + emit rust -> rustc -O3 (shared .rlib)`
Cold-toolchain payback N*_cold_1kernel (charging the full one-time librce_rt.rlib build energy to a single kernel) and 20-kernel amortized payback N*_amortized_20

provenance.energy_separation_rule: est_j, reported_j, and measured_j are strictly separated and never summed.
